To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the majority of drivers involved with intersection crashes were alert, and attempted evasive maneuvers, and that the median time to evasive braking and steering were approximately 0.75 s and 0.7 s prior to crash, respectively.

drivers involved in intersection crash events frequently performed evasive maneuvers and that these maneuvers were characterized by a combination of braking and steering, with braking occurring first.

drivers involved in intersection collisions frequently attempt to avoid the crash by braking and steering, but that the timing of the braking is more variable and occurs closer to the time of the crash.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology to assess the effectiveness of an I- ADAS in reducing intersection crashes by quantifying driver evasive maneuvers.
the analysis and characterization of driver evasive maneuver kinematics prior to intersection crashes using EDR data.
the development of an understanding of the driver's role in intersection crashes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
drivers involved in intersection collisions attempted to avoid the crash by braking and steering.
drivers who are involved in intersection crashes attempt to avoid a crash with evasive maneuvers.
drivers who are involved in intersection crashes attempt to brake and turn in an evasive manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
evasive maneuvers were performed frequently and in a timely fashion prior to the crash.
drivers who are involved in intersection crashes are not always at fault.
the average driver is attempting to steer and brake in the same time frame.
The main takeaway from our work is that
drivers involved in intersection accidents are not always at fault.
the driver is a key element to the performance of I-ADAS, and the design and development of I-ADASS must take into account the kinematics of driver behavior prior to a crash.
evasive maneuvers can be detected in real-world crash scenarios.
